hypotheses.paper: V une variété (connexe, séparée, à base dénombrable; plan F6)
hypotheses.note: Hausdorff and second countable unused; connectedness and nonemptiness follow from SimplyConnectedSpace

hypotheses.paper: (implicit) V localement connexe par arcs, needed by the lifting theorem
hypotheses.here: carried as explicit hypothesis for general (G,X); DERIVED for the paper's two cases
hypotheses.note: locPathConnectedSpace_of_proj / locPathConnectedSpace_of_aff from ChartedSpace.locPathConnectedSpace; S(n) is a quotient of R^{n+1} minus 0 (locPathConnectedSpace_S)

hypotheses.paper: tous les jets appartiennent à J(V)
hypotheses.note: IsDeveloping G p := ∀ x, jet x p ∈ jets G X M

hypotheses.paper: défini à une multiplication à gauche près par un élément de GS(n,R) [resp. GA(n,R)]
hypotheses.note: g • p is developing; two developing maps differ by a UNIQUE g

hypotheses.paper: ouvert étalé au-dessus de S(n) (resp. R^n)
hypotheses.note: IsLocalHomeomorph p (kb/0001), and IsGXMorphism into the model

questions: « variété » read per F6; only simple connectedness is used (it gives nonempty + path connected). Local path-connectedness is not a hypothesis of the instantiated statements: it is derived from the charts over S(n) / R^n.

upstream_moves: Benzecri.locPathConnectedSpace_S (and _nonzero) belong in Benzecri.Projective.Sphere (generalisable to Sphere E for E a topological vector space: quotient of the open set E∖0)
Benzecri.Jet.value / Jet.value_jet / eq_jet_of_mem_jets belong in Benzecri.Structure.Basic (Jets section)
kb_proposals: Mathlib's IsCoveringMap.existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts (Topology/Homotopy/Lifting.lean) applied to isCoveringMap_jets gives developing maps in a few lines: the developing map is Filter.Germ.value of the section's germ (jetValue); the étalé basic open {jet y e | y ∈ e.source} pins σ y = jet y e near x.

S(n) is locally path connected as a quotient (IsQuotientMap.locPathConnectedSpace) of the open set {v ≠ 0}; any charted space over S n or Fin n → ℝ is then locally path connected by ChartedSpace.locPathConnectedSpace.
